# Potomac Pediatric Dentistry & Family Orthodontics

> > Comprehensive pediatric dental and orthodontic care in Dumfries, VA with board-certified specialists and sedation options for anxious children.

Potomac Pediatric Dentistry & Family Orthodontics is a full-service pediatric dental practice in Dumfries, Virginia, offering preventive dentistry, emergency care, and orthodontic treatment including braces and early intervention therapy. The practice is led by board-certified pediatric dentists and orthodontists with expertise in special needs dentistry and multiple sedation modalities.

## Key Topics

- Pediatric dentistry
- Board-certified dentists
- Braces and orthodontics
- Sedation dentistry
- Dental emergencies
- Early orthodontic treatment
- Teeth straightening
- Preventive dental care
- Special needs dentistry
- Bite correction
- Orthodontic appliances
- Nitrous oxide
- IV sedation
- Dumfries, VA
- First dentist visit
